Corrected_Value: Min-Max normalization was reported, but the available passage did not establish that it was fitted before splitting or on the complete dataset. Global scaling and full-dataset preprocessing were therefore not confirmed.
Missing-value imputation used information from preceding and subsequent periods. This creates a future-aware input-construction mechanism, although it is not label look-ahead.

The article explicitly described a rolling-window design used instead of random splitting and stated that past observations were used to predict future values. No specific leakage mechanism remained established.
Standardization and PCA were fitted separately on the test set. The resulting test representation therefore used test-distribution information rather than an unchanged training-fitted transformation.
The article explicitly stated that training observations were divided randomly into ten subsets and evaluated using tenfold cross-validation, which is temporally invalid for stock-market forecasting.
